Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Come esperto GMP (m/f/d) nel team di calibrazione, sei l'interfaccia centrale quando si tratta di documentazione chiara, comprensibile e conforme a GMP. Porti al punto processi tecnici complessi e assicurati che i nostri standard e processi siano documentati in ogni momento. Si gioca anche un ruolo importante nella manutenzione del sistema all'interno del programma ASPIRE.

La possibilità

Nel team di calibrazione, puoi aspettarti varie attività:

• SOPs & flussi di processo: Si crea, rivedere e mantenere procedure operative standard (SOP), istruzioni di lavoro e documenti tecnici indipendentemente.

• Integrazione System Maintenance & ASPIRE: Mantenete e aggiornate i dati master e processate nei nostri sistemi di taratura (CCMS / SAP).

• Deviazioni & Change Management: Lei scrive e modifica i rapporti di deviazione (deviazioni) e gli eventi pianificati (cambi) in Veeva Vault.

• Analisi dei rischi e delle cause di radice: Supporti il nostro team con analisi delle cause radice (RCA) e analisi dei rischi (ad esempio FMEA).

• Lavoro di interfaccia: Lei lavora a stretto contatto e a livello degli occhi con i tecnici di calibrazione, manutenzione, ingegneria, produzione, MSAT e qualità.

• Progetti: Porti idee per migliorare la qualità, l'efficienza dei processi di calibrazione e la riduzione dei costi e guidare attivamente la loro implementazione.

Chi sei

• Istruzione: Studi completi (ad esempio ingegneria farmaceutica, ingegneria) o formazione tecnica/farmaceutica comparabile.

• Esperienza: Prima esperienza nella scrittura tecnica (SOP, descrizioni dei processi) – idealmente nell'ambiente farmaceutico regolamentato dal GMP o in un settore tecnico comparabile.

• Qualità & comprensione del sistema: Capisci cosa è importante in SOP, flussi di processo e deviazioni, e portare affinità per la manutenzione del sistema e processi di dati (ad esempio CCMS, Veeva, ASPIRE / SAP).

• Competenze linguistiche: Tedesco fluente e inglese (in parola e scrittura) sono una questione di certo per voi.

• Spirito di squadra & personalità: Lei è utile, flessibile, godere del successo congiunto e vedere se stessi come una persona di contatto affidabile per i Suoi colleghi.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all'avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

The Position

As GMP expert (m/f/d) in the calibration team, you are the central interface when it comes to clear, comprehensible and GMP-compliant documentation. You bring complex technical processes to the point and ensure that our standards and processes are documented audit-proof at all times. You also play an important role in system maintenance within the ASPIRE program.

The possibility

In the calibration team, you can expect varied tasks:

• SOPs & process flows: You create, revise and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions and technical documents independently.

• System Maintenance & ASPIRE Integration: You maintain and update master and process data in our calibration systems (CCMS / SAP).

Who you are

• Education: Completed studies (e.g. pharmaceutical engineering, engineering) or comparable technical/pharmaceutical training.

• Experience: First experience in technical writing (SOPs, process descriptions) – ideally in the GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment or a comparable technical industry.

• Quality & system understanding: You understand what is important in SOPs, process flows and deviations, and bring affinity for system maintenance and data processes (e.g. CCMS, Veeva, ASPIRE / SAP).

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted, and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop, and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Leadership & Network Integration: Lead end-to-end PTDS business strategy, aligning functional initiatives with PTD and R&D Vision 2030, while overseeing annual strategy reviews, SQDEC goal setting, and global business project portfolio management (bPPM).

• Digital & AI Transformation: Act as the enterprise business integrator driving core digital, ERP, and AI roadmaps, including high-visibility programs like ASPIRE (SAP S/4HANA & ICSM migration), CLARA deployment, OMP, and Analytics & Reporting (A&R).

• Operational Excellence & Capability Building: Direct line-manage the PTD OE Team Lead and OE Hub to champion Lean Six Sigma methodologies, Kaizen events, and root cause analyses across PTDx projects to cultivate Lean capabilities globally.

• Global Resource & Financial Planning: Lead cross-functional T0–T3 budget rounds, managing 1-year operational resourcing and 3–5-year strategic financial horizons, including clinical trial study-related costs (PVC planning), in partnership with Global Demand & Supply Planning and Product Portfolio Teams.

• Business Continuity & Risk Management: Establish and govern robust risk management frameworks, emergency incident response procedures (LEM), and Business Continuity Management (BCM) strategies to ensure resilient clinical supply chain operations globally.

• End-to-End Process Management: Maintain business process ownership across Plan-to-Deliver operations, ensuring regulatory compliance, high-quality master data, and global process standardization across complex supply networks.

• Environmental Sustainability: Oversee sustainability and carbon reduction initiatives across the global clinical supply chain, line-managing the PTD Sustainability Lead and driving CO2 sensitivity analyses and reporting.

• Executive People & Matrix Leadership: Empower and direct line-manage/matrix-lead a diverse, multicultural team across primary global hubs (Kaiseraugst/Basel, South San Francisco, Mississauga) to foster high engagement, talent flow, and organizational development.

Who you are:

• Educational Background: Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or Business Administration; a Master’s degree, MBA, or advanced degree is strongly preferred.

• Industry Experience: Bring 15+ years of progressive professional experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare industry, with deep domain expertise in global clinical trial supply operations and regulatory environments.

• Leadership & Matrix Management: Demonstrate 5+ years of direct line management and executive leadership experience, successfully guiding large, cross-functional, multi-site teams across complex matrix organizations.

• Transformation & Enterprise Systems: Proven track record leading major digital transformations, Agile/SAFe frameworks, and enterprise ERP implementations (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, OMP, or legacy SAP).

• Strategic & Financial Acumen: Possess demonstrated expertise in long-range strategic planning, global resourcing plans, study-cost management (PVC), project portfolio controls (bPPM), and functional budget governance.

• Process Excellence & Professional Certifications: Hold recognized certifications such as PMP or Lean/Six Sigma Black Belt (or equivalent), with a proven history of embedding Operational Excellence (OE) and Continuous Improvement methodologies.

• Global Readiness & Languages: Fluent in English (German language skills are an advantage), with the flexibility and willingness to travel internationally up to 10%.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare!

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity

• Lead the Modelling & Simulation Centre of Excellence (CoE): Define the strategy, vision, roadmap, standards, and governance for M&S across Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC), matrix-leading a cross-departmental community of 20+ experts around shared organizational priorities.

• Drive Strategic Alignment & Leadership: Influence and guide senior leaders across an organization of 700+ employees, proposing innovative ways of working, prioritizing high-impact applications, and serving as a key cross-functional connector without direct formal authority.

• Shape End-to-End M&S Strategy: Identify where mechanistic, hybrid, and data-driven modelling deliver maximum impact across both Drug Substance and Drug Product lifecycles—from early lab development through scale-up, technology transfer, and commercial manufacturing.

• Deliver High-Impact Process Solutions: Act as the senior technical authority on complex development challenges, leveraging chemical engineering principles to optimize processes, support experimental design, refine scale-up/scale-down models, and support regulatory submissions.

• Build Reusable Digital Capabilities: Spearhead the creation of validated model libraries, digital twins, scale-up tools, and self-service applications to establish consistent, scalable modelling standards and reduce duplicated effort across project teams.

• Drive Organizational Capability & Literacy: Coach and mentor scientists and engineers, elevating M&S literacy across project teams while fostering seamless collaboration between domain experts, modellers, data scientists, and technical partner functions.

• Connect Roche with External Innovation: Establish external partnerships with universities, research consortia, and technology vendors to evaluate emerging scientific advances and integrate cutting-edge M&S methodologies into the organization.

• Manage Hardware & Software Strategy: Influence high-value technology investments and vendor partnerships, maintaining governance and decision-making over a six-figure software portfolio.

Who You Are

• Advanced Academic Foundation: Master’s degree or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a closely related discipline.

• Extensive Process & Modelling Leadership: 12+ years of professional experience in process engineering and M&S within the pharmaceutical or science-based industries, demonstrating deep technical expertise across end-to-end Drug Substance and Drug Product development.

• Proven Matrix Leadership & Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives across matrixed organizations, challenge the status quo, and align senior decision-makers across PTD and R&D without relying on direct organizational authority to champion, advocate for, and bring visibility to M&S initiatives.

• Advanced Modelling & Programming Expertise: Hands-on experience with industry-standard modelling platforms (e.g., gPROMS/gWAP, Dynochem) and scientific programming languages (Python, MATLAB), combined with strong knowledge of scale-up/down dynamics and pharmaceutical manufacturing phenomena.

• Integration of Emerging Technologies: Deep understanding of classical mechanistic modelling, computational fluid dynamics (e.g., COMSOL, M-Star), model-based process control, PAT, and emerging AI/ML paradigms (including hybrid models, digital twins, and agentic AI).

• Strategic & Conceptual Mindset: Exceptional conceptual thinking skills, with a proven track record of translating complex individual technical problems into reusable model libraries, digital capabilities, and scalable organizational frameworks.

• Strong Communication & Scientific Collaboration: Fluent in English (written and spoken) with exceptional communication skills to translate sophisticated modelling concepts, assumptions, and limitations into clear, actionable insights for both technical specialists and leaders.

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

COMSOL, M-Star), du contrôle des processus basé sur les modèles, du PAT et des paradigmes émergents d'IA/ML (y compris les modèles hybrides, les jumeaux numériques et l'IA agentique).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modality (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly versatile Scientist to serve as our primary operational and computational architect embedded in the wet-lab scientific community. In this role, you will bridge the gap between physical laboratory benches and advanced digital infrastructure. You will have the chance to shape how active learning loops could fundamentally rethink small molecule assay development for screening and profiling by building future ready agentic AI workflows from assay design to data delivery. Concurrently, you will champion platform adoption across the department, ensuring bench scientists are trained and supported on core tools. This profile requires a unique combination of biological literacy and data engineering acumen to successfully design closed-loop analytical systems, minimize operational bottlenecks, and transition raw screening readouts into predictive, FAIR-compliant data assets.

• Lead the co-development, operational rollout, and continuous training for our end-to-end assay development and screening laboratory information management systems (LIMS), ensuring complete, traceable data trails and digital twins.

• Design and integrate cutting-edge Agentic AI tools and Design of Experiments (DoE) frameworks.

• Build and adjust pipelines that connect specialized raw instrument outputs directly with databases to achieve robust FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) data standards.

• Act as a change agent by coordinating user onboarding, training bench scientists, and championing platform adoption across the broader scientific community.

• Make a direct impact by accelerating assay design and execution times, lowering processing error rates, and resolving operational bottlenecks for specialized teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a Ph.D. or M.S. in Computational Biology, Scientific Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biology/Biochemistry with a strong computational focus, or a related quantitative scientific discipline.

• You bring solid experience in cellular, biochemical, or biophysical systems and are familiar with FAIR data management standards.

• You have proven experience working with laboratory informatics environments (such as LIMS or electronic lab notebooks) alongside wet-lab operations incl. Design of Experiments.

• You demonstrate strong programming proficiency, including building or maintaining databases, automating data extraction, and working with ML/LLM API integration.

• You are a collaborative communicator with a customer-centric mindset, ready to train cross-functional users and manage stakeholder relationships effectively.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

L'organizzazione di Modalità terapeutica (TMo), responsabile per la traduzione della biologia delle malattie in candidati di droga di alta qualità attraverso piccole molecole, grandi molecole, oligonucleotidi e medicine genomiche. Integrando una profonda esperienza di modalità con la collaborazione interdisciplinare, TMo guida l'innovazione all'interno e attraverso piattaforme per consentire un impatto terapeutico differenziato e sostenibile.

L'opportunità
Stiamo cercando uno scienziato altamente versatile per servire come nostro architetto operativo e computazionale primario incorporato nella comunità scientifica bagnata-lab. In questo ruolo, colmare il divario tra banchi di laboratorio fisici e infrastrutture digitali avanzate. Avrete la possibilità di modellare come i loop di apprendimento attivi potrebbero fondamentalmente ripensare lo sviluppo di analisi di piccole molecole per la proiezione e la profilazione costruendo futuri flussi di lavoro agentici AI pronti da progettazione di saggi alla consegna dei dati. Contemporaneamente, sarai campione dell'adozione della piattaforma in tutto il dipartimento, assicurando che gli scienziati della panca siano addestrati e supportati su strumenti di base. Questo profilo richiede una combinazione unica di alfabetizzazione biologica e di acume di ingegneria dei dati per progettare con successo sistemi analitici a ciclo chiuso, minimizzare i colli di bottiglia operativi, e le letture di screening raw di transizione in attività di dati predittive e conformi alla FAIR.

• Condurre il co-sviluppo, il rollout operativo e la formazione continua per il nostro sviluppo end-to-end di analisi e screening dei sistemi di gestione delle informazioni di laboratorio (LIMS), assicurando percorsi dati completi e tracciabili e gemelli digitali.

• Progettare e integrare gli strumenti di AI Agentic all'avanguardia e le strutture di Design of Experiments (DoE).

• Costruire e regolare le tubazioni che collegano le uscite di strumenti grezzi specializzati direttamente con i database per raggiungere robusti standard di dati FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable e Reusable).

• Agire come agente di cambiamento coordinando l'utente onboarding, gli scienziati della panca di formazione, e sostenendo l'adozione della piattaforma in tutta la comunità scientifica più ampia.

• Fai un impatto diretto accelerando i tempi di progettazione e esecuzione del saggio, abbassando i tassi di errore di elaborazione e risolvendo i colli di bottiglia operativi per le squadre specializzate.

Chi sei

• Hai un Ph.D. o M.S. in Biologia Computazionale, Informatica Scientifica, Bioinformatica, Biologia/Biochimica con una forte attenzione computazionale, o una disciplina scientifica quantitativa relativa.

• Porti una solida esperienza nei sistemi cellulari, biochimici o biofisici e conosci gli standard di gestione dei dati FAIR.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza di lavoro con ambienti informatici di laboratorio (come LIMS o notebook elettronici di laboratorio) insieme a operazioni a lastra bagnata incl. Progettazione di Esperimenti.

• Lei dimostra una forte competenza di programmazione, tra cui la costruzione o il mantenimento di database, l'estrazione automatica dei dati e il lavoro con l'integrazione ML/LLM API.

• Sei un comunicatore collaborativo con una mentalità orientata al cliente, pronto a formare utenti interfunzionali e gestire efficacemente le relazioni degli stakeholder.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie in continuo cambiamento. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

Therapeutic Modality (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly versatile Scientist to serve as our primary operational and computational architect embedded in the wet-lab scientific community. In this role, you will bridge the gap between physical laboratory benches and advanced digital infrastructure. You will have the chance to shape how active learning loops could fundamentally rethink small molecule assay development for screening and profiling by building future ready agentic AI workflows from assay design to data delivery. Concurrently, you will champion platform adoption across the department, ensuring bench scientists are trained and supported on core tools. This profile requires a unique combination of biological literacy and data engineering acumen to successfully design closed-loop analytical systems, minimize operational bottlenecks, and transition raw screening readouts into predictive, FAIR-compliant data assets.

• Lead the co-development, operational rollout, and continuous training for our end-to-end assay development and screening laboratory information management systems (LIMS), ensuring complete, traceable data trails and digital twins.

• Design and integrate cutting-edge Agentic AI tools and Design of Experiments (DoE) frameworks.

• Build and adjust pipelines that connect specialized raw instrument outputs directly with databases to achieve robust FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) data standards.

• Act as a change agent by coordinating user onboarding, training bench scientists, and championing platform adoption across the broader scientific community.

• Make a direct impact by accelerating assay design and execution times, lowering processing error rates, and resolving operational bottlenecks for specialized teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a Ph.D. or M.S. in Computational Biology, Scientific Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biology/Biochemistry with a strong computational focus, or a related quantitative scientific discipline.

• You bring solid experience in cellular, biochemical, or biophysical systems and are familiar with FAIR data management standards.

• You have proven experience working with laboratory informatics environments (such as LIMS or electronic lab notebooks) alongside wet-lab operations incl. Design of Experiments.

• You demonstrate strong programming proficiency, including building or maintaining databases, automating data extraction, and working with ML/LLM API integration.

• You are a collaborative communicator with a customer-centric mindset, ready to train cross-functional users and manage stakeholder relationships effectively.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen.

Therapeutische Modalität (TMo) Organisation, verantwortlich für die Übersetzung der Krankheitsbiologie in qualitativ hochwertige Arzneimittelkandidaten über kleine Moleküle, große Moleküle, Oligonukleotide und genomische Medikamente. Durch die Integration von fundiertem Modalitäts-Know-how mit interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit fördert TMo Innovationen innerhalb und zwischen Plattformen, um eine differenzierte, nachhaltige therapeutische Wirkung zu ermöglichen.

Die Chance
Wir suchen einen äußerst vielseitigen Wissenschaftler, der als unser primärer Betriebs- und Rechenarchitekt in die wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft der Nasslabore eingebettet ist. In dieser Rolle schließen Sie die Lücke zwischen physischen Laborbänken und fortschrittlicher digitaler Infrastruktur. Sie haben die Möglichkeit zu gestalten, wie aktive Lernschleifen die Entwicklung von Kleinmolekül-Assays für Screening und Profiling grundlegend überdenken können, indem Sie zukünftige agentische KI-Workflows vom Assay-Design bis zur Datenbereitstellung erstellen. Gleichzeitig werden Sie sich für die Einführung von Plattformen in der gesamten Abteilung einsetzen, um sicherzustellen, dass Laborwissenschaftler in Kernwerkzeugen geschult und unterstützt werden. Dieses Profil erfordert eine einzigartige Kombination aus biologischer Kompetenz und Data-Engineering-Charakter, um erfolgreich geschlossene Analysesysteme zu entwerfen, betriebliche Engpässe zu minimieren und rohe Screening-Auslesungen in prädiktive, FAIR-konforme Datenbestände umzuwandeln.

• Führen Sie die gemeinsame Entwicklung, den operativen Rollout und die kontinuierliche Schulung für unsere End-to-End-Assay-Entwicklung und das Screening von Laborinformationsmanagementsystemen (LIMS) und gewährleisten Sie vollständige, rückverfolgbare Datenspuren und digitale Zwillinge.

• Entwerfen und integrieren Sie modernste Agentic AI Tools und Design of Experiments (DoE) Frameworks.

• Erstellen und Anpassen von Pipelines, die spezialisierte Rohgeräte direkt mit Datenbanken verbinden, um robuste FAIR-Datenstandards (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable und Reusable) zu erreichen.

• Handeln Sie als Change Agent, indem Sie das Onboarding der Benutzer koordinieren, Laborwissenschaftler ausbilden und sich für die Einführung von Plattformen in der breiteren wissenschaftlichen Gemeinschaft einsetzen.

Wer du bist

• Sie haben einen Ph.D. oder MS in Computational Biology, Scientific Informatics, Bioinformatics, Biology / Biochemie mit einem starken Rechenfokus oder einer verwandten quantitativen wissenschaftlichen Disziplin.

• Sie bringen fundierte Erfahrung in zellulären, biochemischen oder biophysikalischen Systemen mit und sind mit den FAIR-Datenmanagementstandards vertraut.

• Sie haben nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Laborinformatik-Umgebungen (wie LIMS oder elektronischen Labor-Notebooks) neben Nasslaborbetrieben inkl. Design von Experimenten.

• Sie weisen starke Programmierkenntnisse auf, einschließlich des Aufbaus oder der Pflege von Datenbanken, der Automatisierung der Datenextraktion und der Arbeit mit der ML / LLM-API-Integration.

• Sie sind ein kollaborativer Kommunikator mit einer kundenorientierten Denkweise, der bereit ist, funktionsübergreifende Benutzer zu schulen und Stakeholder-Beziehungen effektiv zu verwalten.

Bei Roche streben wir nach lebensverändernden Gesundheitslösungen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu machen, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie.

L'organisation de la Modalité thérapeutique (TMo), responsable de la traduction de la biologie des maladies en candidats pharmaceutiques de haute qualité à travers les petites molécules, les grandes molécules, les oligonucléotides et les médicaments génomiques. En intégrant une grande expertise en modalité avec une collaboration interdisciplinaire, TMo stimule l'innovation au sein des plateformes et entre elles pour permettre un impact thérapeutique différencié et durable.

L'opportunité
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique hautement polyvalent qui sera notre principal architecte opérationnel et computationnel intégré à la communauté scientifique des laboratoires humides. Dans ce rôle, vous comblerez l'écart entre les bancs de laboratoire physique et l'infrastructure numérique avancée. Vous aurez la chance de façonner comment les boucles d'apprentissage actives pourraient fondamentalement repenser le développement des essais de petites molécules pour le dépistage et le profilage en construisant de futurs flux de travail d'IA d'agents prêts de la conception des essais à la livraison des données. Parallèlement, vous serez champions de l'adoption de la plate-forme dans l'ensemble du département, assurant la formation et le soutien des chercheurs sur les outils de base. Ce profil exige une combinaison unique de connaissances biologiques et d'ingénierie des données pour concevoir avec succès des systèmes d'analyse en boucle fermée, réduire au minimum les goulots d'étranglement opérationnels et transformer les lectures brutes de dépistage en données prédictives et conformes aux normes FAIR.

• Diriger le co-développement, le déploiement opérationnel et la formation continue de nos systèmes de gestion de l'information de laboratoire de bout en bout (SIGI), en assurant des pistes de données complètes et traçables et des jumeaux numériques.

• Concevoir et intégrer des outils d'IA Agentic de pointe et des cadres de conception d'expériences (DoE).

• Construisez et ajustez des pipelines qui relient directement les sorties d'instruments bruts spécialisés aux bases de données afin d'atteindre des normes de données FAIR (fichables, accessibles, interopérables et réutilisables).

• Agir en tant qu'agent de changement en coordonnant les utilisateurs à bord, en formant des spécialistes et en faisant la promotion de l'adoption d'une plateforme dans l'ensemble de la communauté scientifique.

• Faire un impact direct en accélérant la conception et le temps d'exécution des essais, en réduisant les taux d'erreur de traitement et en éliminant les goulets d'étranglement opérationnels pour les équipes spécialisées.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'une maîtrise en biologie computationnelle, en informatique scientifique, en bioinformatique, en biologie/biochimie avec une forte concentration computationnelle, ou d'une discipline scientifique quantitative connexe.

• Vous apportez une solide expérience dans les systèmes cellulaires, biochimiques ou biophysiques et connaissez les normes de gestion des données FAIR.

• Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail avec des environnements informatiques de laboratoire (tels que les LIMS ou les carnets électroniques de laboratoire) ainsi que des opérations en laboratoire humide, y compris. Conception des expériences.

• Vous démontrez une solide compétence en programmation, y compris la création ou la maintenance de bases de données, l'automatisation de l'extraction de données et le travail avec l'intégration de l'API ML/LLM.

• Vous êtes un communicateur collaboratif avec une mentalité centrée sur le client, prêt à former des utilisateurs interfonctionnels et à gérer efficacement les relations avec les intervenants.

Chez Roche, nous nous efforçons de fournir des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde, c'est l'endroit pour vous.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Principal Process Engineer in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) and member of the Process Engineering and Manufacturing group in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products from Phase 1 up to Launch. Activities encompass formulation and aseptic manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. The Pharmaceutical Development Process Engineer ensures robust clinical and commercial process designs for effective process validation and successful commercialization.

The Opportunity

As an experienced scientist in the process development and launch of parenterals synthetic molecules (oligonucleotides, peptides and small molecules) , your major responsibilities in this position are the following:

• Development of robust manufacturing processes for parenteral liquid and lyophilized formulations including scale-up, process characterization & validation and transfer to global commercial manufacturing sites.

• Design and hands-on execution of process characterization/process design studies as part of parenteral synthetic molecule drug product process development

• Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as transfer project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and international committees within Roche.

• Collaborate cross-functionally and with manufacturing sites to ensure alignment and successful project execution, act as a single point of contact for DP Process Development.

• Author relevant sections in global regulatory submissions for Phase 1-3 and international marketing applications

Who you are

As the successful candidate you hold a Ph.D. or master degree in chemistry, chemical/process engineering or related fields and bring a minimum of 5 years of professional experience (industry) in process development DP manufacturing related fields of parenteral synthetic molecule dosage forms.

• Expertise in parenteral process development, technology transfers to commercial sites and regulatory submissions.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate program risk and submission risk from a drug product process development and manufacturing standpoint.

• Design / Justification of down-scale models incl. process parameters definition and characterization

• Proven track record of DP SM parenteral launch. Combination products experience is a plus.

• Proven experience authoring DP sections of NDA and/or BLA related to molecules designed for parenteral use.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

• Willingness to travel internationally (up to 20%)

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. • Design / Giustificazione dei modelli su scala ridotta incl. definizione dei parametri di processo e caratterizzazione

• Entwicklung robuster Herstellungsverfahren für parenterale flüssige und lyophilisierte Formulierungen, einschließlich Scale-up, Prozesscharakterisierung & Validierung und Transfer zu globalen kommerziellen Fertigungsstandorten.

• Design und praktische Durchführung von Prozesscharakterisierung / Prozessdesign-Studien im Rahmen der parenteralen synthetischen Molekül-Arzneimittelprodukt-Prozessentwicklung

• Vertretung von Pharmaceutical Development als Transferprojektleiter in globalen CMC-Teams, funktioneller Vertreter in funktionsübergreifenden Teams und internationalen Gremien innerhalb von Roche.

• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend und mit Fertigungsstandorten zusammen, um die Ausrichtung und erfolgreiche Projektdurchführung sicherzustellen, und fungieren Sie als Ansprechpartner für die DP-Prozessentwicklung.

• Autor relevante Abschnitte in globalen regulatorischen Einreichungen für Phase 1-3 und internationale Marketinganwendungen

Wer du bist

Als erfolgreicher Kandidat haben Sie einen Ph.D. oder Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Chemie / Verfahrenstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen und bringen mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (Industrie) in der Prozessentwicklung DP Herstellung verwandten Bereichen der parenteralen synthetischen Molekül-Dosierungsformen.

• Expertise in der parenteralen Prozessentwicklung, Technologietransfers an kommerzielle Standorte und regulatorische Einreichungen.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, das Programmrisiko und das Einreichungsrisiko von einem Standpunkt der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Arzneimittelprodukten aus zu bewerten.

• Design / Begründung von Downscale-Modellen inkl. Prozessparameterdefinition und -charakterisierung

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz der DP SM parenteral Start. Kombinationsprodukte Erfahrung ist ein Plus.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen bei der Erstellung von DP-Abschnitten von NDA und/oder BLA im Zusammenhang mit Molekülen, die für den parenteralen Gebrauch entwickelt wurden.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kollaboratives Verhalten mit End-to-End- und globalem Denken sowie hervorragende Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management

• Bereitschaft, international zu reisen (bis zu 20%)

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Weiterentwicklung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

En tant qu'ingénieur principal en développement pharmaceutique, vous faites partie du département Développement pharmaceutique de Pharma Technical Development (PTD) et membre du groupe Ingénierie et fabrication de procédés à Bâle, Suisse. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de médicaments parentéraux de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication aseptiques pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. L'ingénieur en processus de développement pharmaceutique assure la robustesse des conceptions cliniques et commerciales pour une validation efficace des procédés et une commercialisation réussie.

L'opportunité

En tant que scientifique expérimenté dans le développement et le lancement de molécules synthétiques parentérales (oligonucléotides, peptides et petites molécules), vos principales responsabilités dans cette position sont les suivantes:

• Mise au point de procédés de fabrication robustes pour les formulations filérales liquides et lyophilisées, y compris la mise à l'échelle, la caractérisation et la validation des procédés et le transfert vers les sites de fabrication commerciaux mondiaux.

• Conception et exécution pratique d'études de caractérisation/de conception de processus dans le cadre du développement de produits médicamenteux à molécule synthétique parentérale

• Représentation du développement pharmaceutique comme chef de projet de transfert dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités internationaux de Roche.

• Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle et avec les sites de fabrication pour assurer l'alignement et la réussite de l'exécution des projets, agir comme un point de contact unique pour le développement des processus de PDD.

• Auteur des sections pertinentes des présentations réglementaires mondiales pour la phase 1-3 et les demandes de commercialisation internationale

Qui vous êtes

En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'une maîtrise en chimie, en génie chimique/procédé ou dans des domaines connexes et vous apportez un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans le développement de procédés DP fabrication de domaines connexes de formes posologiques de molécules synthétiques parentérales.

• Expertise en développement de processus parentaux, transfert de technologie vers des sites commerciaux et présentations réglementaires.

• Capacité démontrée d'évaluer le risque du programme et le risque de présentation du point de vue du développement et de la fabrication d'un produit pharmaceutique.

• Conception / Justification de modèles à échelle réduite incluant définition et caractérisation des paramètres de processus

• Antécédents prouvés du lancement initial de DP SM. L'expérience de produits combinés est un plus.

• Expérience éprouvée auteur de sections DP de NDA et/ou BLA liées à des molécules conçues pour une utilisation parentérale.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une pensée de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants

• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger (jusqu'à 20 %)

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Section Lead DP Process Engineering in Pharmaceutical Development in Basel, Switzerland, you are a member of the global Drug Product Process Engineering and Manufacturing team as part of the Department Biologics Pharmaceutical Development. The Department Biologics Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (synthetic molecules and biologics) from Phase 1 up to Launch, including formulation and aseptic process development. The Pharmaceutical Development Process Engineer ensures robust clinical and commercial process designs for effective process validation and successful commercialization of sterile drug products.
This position is focused on robust process development for parenteral drug products to drive excellence and innovation and ensure seamless network-wide execution across biologics, synthetic molecules, and peptides.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers focused on developing sterile DP manufacturing processes across clinical and commercial stages. As part of the global team, you will ensure the implementation of harmonized, science- and risk-based strategies that enable efficient technology transfers and process validation in collaboration with internal and external manufacturing network partners. Furthermore, the Section Lead will foster a growth-oriented, high-performing team environment, enabling staff to develop their skills and contribute their best work.

• Provide technical oversight and strategic guidance for a team responsible for the development of robust manufacturing processes for parenteral liquid and lyophilized formulations including scale-up, process characterization & validation and transfer to global commercial manufacturing sites.

• Lead, coach and develop a team of approximately 8-12 process engineers focused on drug product process development across various modalities such as Biologics, synthetic molecules, peptides

• Ensure process designs for clinical and commercial stages are robust for effective validation and successful commercialization

• Represent the function during interactions with various interfaces and in stakeholder meetings, emphasizing global harmonization through collaboration, Lean principles, and an innovation mindset.

• Collaborate cross-functionally and with manufacturing sites, including partnerships with CMOs, to ensure alignment and successful project execution.

Who you are

• You hold a Ph.D. in relevant scientific or engineering disciplines (preferred) or have commensurate experience.

• You have at least 8 years of relevant experience in the biopharmaceutical industry and proven ability to shape and lead teams.

• You have experience in leading or managing groups of scientists and engineers, as well as working with departmental senior staff for project and people decisions.

• You demonstrate capabilities to lead, motivate, and develop people, focusing on optimum utilization of talent and skills.

• You possess strong technical expertise in parenteral process development and readiness to oversee end-to-end pharmaceutical development, including regulatory submissions

• You have a proven ability to prioritize resources effectively across the network and sponsor strategic process engineering projects, ensuring alignment and successful execution within complex organizational structures

• You are able to travel up to 20% domestically and internationally

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione
In qualità di Sezione Lead DP Process Engineering in Sviluppo Farmaceutico a Basilea, Svizzera, sei un membro del team globale Drug Product Process Engineering and Manufacturing come parte del Dipartimento Biologics Pharmaceutical Development. Il Dipartimento Biologics Pharmaceutical Development è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali ( molecole sintetiche e biologiche) dalla fase 1 al lancio, compresa la formulazione e lo sviluppo di processo asettico. L'Ingegnere di processo di sviluppo farmaceutico garantisce robusti progetti di processo clinici e commerciali per una valida validazione del processo e una commercializzazione di prodotti sterili.
Questa posizione è focalizzata sullo sviluppo di processo robusto per i prodotti farmaceutici parenterali per guidare l'eccellenza e l'innovazione e garantire l'esecuzione senza soluzione di rete tra biologici, molecole sintetiche e peptidi.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, si porterà un team di ingegneri di processo focalizzato sullo sviluppo di processi sterili di produzione DP in fasi cliniche e commerciali. Nell'ambito del team globale, ti garantirai l'implementazione di strategie armonizzate, scientifiche e basate sui rischi che consentono trasferimenti tecnologici efficienti e la validazione dei processi in collaborazione con partner di rete di produzione interni ed esterni. Inoltre, la Sezione Lead promuoverà un ambiente di team ad alta intensità di crescita, consentendo al personale di sviluppare le proprie competenze e contribuire al loro miglior lavoro.

• Fornire una supervisione tecnica e una guida strategica per un team responsabile dello sviluppo di processi di produzione robusti per formulazioni liquide e liofilizzate parenterali, tra cui scale-up, caratterizzazione di processo e validazione e trasferimento a siti di produzione commerciale globale.

• Piombo, allenatore e sviluppare un team di circa 8-12 ingegneri di processo focalizzati sullo sviluppo del processo di droga in varie modalità come Biologics, molecole sintetiche, peptidi

• Assicurare i progetti di processo per le fasi cliniche e commerciali sono robusti per una validazione efficace e una commercializzazione di successo

• Rappresentare la funzione durante le interazioni con varie interfacce e nelle riunioni degli stakeholder, sottolineando l'armonizzazione globale attraverso la collaborazione, i principi Lean e una mentalità dell'innovazione.

• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale e con siti di produzione, tra cui partnership con CMO, per garantire l'allineamento e l'esecuzione di progetti di successo.

Chi sei

• Hai un dottorato in discipline scientifiche o ingegneristiche rilevanti (preferito) o hai esperienza commisurata.

• Hai almeno 8 anni di esperienza rilevante nell'industria biofarmaceutica e comprovata capacità di modellare e guidare i team.

• Hai esperienza in gruppi leader o gestione di scienziati e ingegneri, oltre a lavorare con personale senior dipartimentale per le decisioni di progetto e persone.

• Lei dimostra le capacità di condurre, motivare e sviluppare le persone, concentrandosi sull'utilizzo ottimale di talento e abilità.

• Possiedi una forte competenza tecnica nello sviluppo del processo parenterale e nella disponibilità a supervisionare lo sviluppo farmaceutico end-to-end, comprese le sottomissioni normative

• Hai una comprovata capacità di priorizzare le risorse in modo efficace attraverso la rete e sponsorizzare progetti di ingegneria dei processi strategici, garantendo allineamento ed esecuzione di successo all'interno di strutture organizzative complesse

• Siete in grado di viaggiare fino al 20% a livello nazionale e internazionale

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

En outre, le chef de section favorisera un environnement d'équipe axé sur la croissance et performant, permettant au personnel de développer ses compétences et de contribuer à son meilleur travail.

• Fournir une supervision technique et des orientations stratégiques à une équipe responsable de la mise au point de procédés de fabrication robustes pour les formulations parentérales liquides et lyophilisées, y compris la mise à l'échelle, la caractérisation et la validation des procédés et le transfert aux sites de fabrication commerciaux mondiaux.

• Diriger, coacher et développer une équipe d'environ 8-12 ingénieurs de processus axés sur le développement de processus de produits pharmaceutiques selon diverses modalités telles que les produits biologiques, les molécules synthétiques, les peptides

• Veiller à ce que les conceptions de processus pour les étapes cliniques et commerciales soient robustes pour une validation efficace et une commercialisation réussie

• Représenter la fonction pendant les interactions avec diverses interfaces et lors des réunions des parties prenantes, en mettant l'accent sur l'harmonisation mondiale grâce à la collaboration, aux principes de maigre et à un état d'esprit d'innovation.

• Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle et avec les sites de fabrication, y compris les partenariats avec les OCM, pour assurer l'alignement et la réussite de l'exécution des projets.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences ou en génie (préféré) ou d'une expérience équivalente.

• Vous avez au moins 8 ans d'expérience pertinente dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique et vous avez prouvé votre capacité à former et diriger des équipes.

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la direction ou la gestion de groupes de scientifiques et d'ingénieurs, ainsi que dans la collaboration avec les cadres supérieurs du Ministère pour les décisions relatives aux projets et aux personnes.

• Vous démontrez des capacités pour diriger, motiver et développer les gens, en mettant l'accent sur l'utilisation optimale des talents et des compétences.

• Vous possédez une solide expertise technique dans le développement de processus parentaux et vous êtes prêt à superviser le développement de produits pharmaceutiques de bout en bout, y compris les présentations réglementaires

• Vous avez une capacité éprouvée de prioriser efficacement les ressources dans l'ensemble du réseau et de parrainer des projets stratégiques d'ingénierie des processus, en assurant l'alignement et l'exécution réussie au sein de structures organisationnelles complexes

• Vous êtes en mesure de voyager jusqu'à 20% à l'échelle nationale et internationale

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our Enterprise Metadata Management team for a high-impact, six-month internship. Your core mission is to scale our AI metadata offering for multi-domain, enterprise-wide adoption. By adapting and fine-tuning AI agents, you will improve data discoverability, trust, and compliance in a highly regulated environment. You will not just be prototyping, you will take part of a project that moves directly into production, guided by experienced engineers.

The Opportunity
The Enterprise Metadata Management area is a cornerstone of our digital and agentic transformation, serving as the "brain" of our data ecosystem. In an era where data volume and complexity are accelerating, our mission is to transform raw information into a discoverable, high-trust asset. We focus on building and scaling AI-driven metadata solutions that move beyond manual tagging toward automated curation and intelligent discovery.
Our team sits at the intersection of cutting-edge engineering and strategic business value. We are responsible for developing technologically agnostic frameworks that allow for seamless integration across diverse platforms, ensuring that business lineage and data provenance are transparent and scalable at the enterprise level. By leveraging machine learning and automated curation, we enable the organization to understand not just what data we have, but its context, quality, and lifecycle.

By joining this team, you will be working in a high-impact environment, redefining the backbone of our metadata strategy. We don't just manage data, we build the maps that allow the entire enterprise to navigate it with confidence.

Responsibilities

• Scale & Optimize AI Agents: Extend metadata agents across new business domains using prompt design, RAG, and model fine-tuning.

• Evaluate & Improve: Build evaluation sets to measure agent performance on classification and quality checks. Analyze failures and design confidence scoring/fallback logic to ensure trustworthy outputs.

• Data & Integration: Collaborate with subject-matter experts to prepare annotated datasets. Integrate agent outputs into existing APIs, lightweight apps, and enterprise workflows.

• MLOps & Experimentation: Establish repeatable, tracked experiments with versioned datasets to ensure continuous, reproducible improvements.

• Agile Collaboration: Work in sprints alongside engineers and data stewards. Present methods, limitations, and demos to both technical and business stakeholders.

Who You Are

• Education: Advanced Bachelor’s or Master’s student in AI, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Core Technical Skills: Strong Python proficiency with hands-on experience in PyTorch/TensorFlow, classic ML tooling, SQL, and Git/Docker/Linux. Experience building lightweight apps is a plus.

• AI/ML Experience: Practical knowledge of the full ML lifecycle. Preferred exposure to LLMs, agent frameworks, and reward design.

• Domain Interest: Familiarity with metadata, data catalogs, or lineage. A strong interest in ensuring data quality and traceability in regulated environments.

• Soft Skills: Clear written and spoken English, intellectual curiosity, persistence, and the ability to explain complex technical results to non-technical audiences.

Additional information

• Please include CV in English to your application.

• Due to regulatory requirements, non-EU/non-EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from their university confirming that the internship is mandatory and specifying its required duration, as well as a certificate of enrollment.

• You are currently enrolled at a university (Bachelor's or Master's degree), or you have completed your studies within the 12 months prior to the internship start date.

We are looking forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Unisciti al nostro team Enterprise Metadata Management per uno stage di sei mesi ad alto impatto. La vostra missione principale è di scalare la nostra offerta di metadati AI per l'adozione multi-dominio, a livello aziendale. Adattando e perfezionando gli agenti dell'IA, migliorerai la scoperta dei dati, la fiducia e la conformità in un ambiente altamente regolamentato. Non sarete solo prototipando, prenderete parte a un progetto che si muove direttamente in produzione, guidato da ingegneri esperti.

L'opportunità
L'area Enterprise Metadata Management è una pietra angolare della nostra trasformazione digitale e agentica, che funge da "brain" del nostro ecosistema dati. In un'epoca in cui il volume e la complessità dei dati stanno accelerando, la nostra missione è quella di trasformare le informazioni grezze in un asset scoperto e di alta fiducia. Ci concentriamo sulla costruzione e scalare soluzioni di metadati basate su AI che vanno oltre il tagging manuale verso la cura automatica e la scoperta intelligente.
Il nostro team si trova all'incrocio tra ingegneria all'avanguardia e valore strategico aziendale. Siamo responsabili dello sviluppo di framework tecnologicamente agnostici che consentono un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità su piattaforme diverse, garantendo che la linea di business e la provenienza dei dati siano trasparenti e scalabili a livello aziendale. Levando l'apprendimento automatico e la cura automatizzata, consentiamo all'organizzazione di capire non solo quali dati abbiamo, ma il suo contesto, la qualità e il ciclo di vita.

Unendo questo team, lavorerai in un ambiente ad alto impatto, ridefinindo la spina dorsale della nostra strategia di metadati. Non gestiamo solo i dati, costruiamo le mappe che permettono all'intera impresa di navigare con fiducia.

responsabilità

• Scale & Optimize AI Agents: Estendere gli agenti di metadati in nuovi domini aziendali utilizzando la progettazione rapida, RAG e la messa a punto del modello.

• Valutare & Migliorare: Costruire i set di valutazione per misurare le prestazioni dell'agente sui controlli di classificazione e qualità. Analizzare i guasti e la fiducia nella progettazione logiche di punteggio/fallback per garantire uscite affidabili.

• Dati & Integrazione: Collabora con esperti soggetti-materia per preparare set di dati annotati. Integrare gli output dell'agente in API esistenti, applicazioni leggere e flussi di lavoro aziendali.

• MLOps & Experimentation: Stabilire esperimenti ripetibili e tracciati con set di dati in versione per garantire miglioramenti continui e riproducibili.

• Agile Collaborazione: Lavorare in sprint insieme a ingegneri e amministratori di dati. Metodi attuali, limitazioni e demo a entrambi gli stakeholder tecnici e aziendali.

Chi sei

• Istruzione: Avanzato Bachelor o Master in AI, Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, o un campo relativo.

• Competenze tecniche di base: Forte competenza Python con esperienza pratica in PyTorch/TensorFlow, utensili ML classici, SQL e Git/Docker/Linux. Esperienza costruzione applicazioni leggere è un plus.

• AI/ML Experience: conoscenza pratica del ciclo di vita ML completo. Preferita esposizione a LLM, quadri di agente e progettazione di ricompensa.

• Interesse di dominio: familiarità con metadati, cataloghi di dati, o lignaggio. Un forte interesse a garantire la qualità e la tracciabilità dei dati in ambienti regolamentati.

• Soft Skills: Chiara inglese scritto e parlato, curiosità intellettuale, persistenza, e la capacità di spiegare complessi risultati tecnici al pubblico non tecnico.

Ulteriori informazioni

• Si prega di includere CV in inglese alla vostra applicazione.

• A causa dei requisiti normativi, i cittadini non UE/non AELS devono fornire un certificato dalla loro università confermando che lo stage è obbligatorio e specificandone la durata necessaria, nonché un certificato di iscrizione.

• Sei attualmente iscritto a un'università (Bachelor's o Master's Degree), o hai completato i tuoi studi entro i 12 mesi prima della data di inizio stage.

Siamo lieti della vostra applicazione!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Treten Sie unserem Enterprise Metadata Management Team für ein hochwirksames, sechsmonatiges Praktikum bei. Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, unser KI-Metadatenangebot für eine unternehmensweite Multi-Domain-Adoption zu skalieren. Durch die Anpassung und Feinabstimmung von KI-Agenten verbessern Sie die Auffindbarkeit, das Vertrauen und die Compliance von Daten in einer stark regulierten Umgebung. Sie werden nicht nur Prototyping sein, Sie werden Teil eines Projekts, das direkt in die Produktion bewegt, von erfahrenen Ingenieuren geführt.

Die Chance
Der Bereich Enterprise Metadata Management ist ein Eckpfeiler unserer digitalen und agentischen Transformation und dient als "Gehirn" unseres Daten-Ökosystems. In einer Zeit, in der sich Datenvolumen und -komplexität beschleunigen, ist es unsere Mission, Rohinformationen in ein auffindbares, vertrauenswürdiges Asset zu verwandeln. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Erstellung und Skalierung von KI-gestützten Metadatenlösungen, die über das manuelle Tagging hinaus in Richtung automatisierter Kuration und intelligenter Entdeckung gehen.
Unser Team befindet sich an der Schnittstelle von modernem Engineering und strategischem Geschäftswert. Wir sind für die Entwicklung technologisch agnostischer Frameworks verantwortlich, die eine nahtlose Integration über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg ermöglichen und sicherstellen, dass Geschäftsabstammung und Datenherkunft auf Unternehmensebene transparent und skalierbar sind. Durch die Nutzung von maschinellem Lernen und automatisierter Kuratierung ermöglichen wir es dem Unternehmen, nicht nur zu verstehen, welche Daten wir haben, sondern auch seinen Kontext, seine Qualität und seinen Lebenszyklus.

Wenn Sie sich diesem Team anschließen, arbeiten Sie in einer einflussreichen Umgebung und definieren das Rückgrat unserer Metadaten-Strategie neu. Wir verwalten nicht nur Daten, wir erstellen Karten, die es dem gesamten Unternehmen ermöglichen, mit Zuversicht zu navigieren.

Zuständigkeiten

• Skalieren und Optimieren von KI-Agenten: Erweitern Sie Metadaten-Agenten in neuen Geschäftsdomänen mit promptem Design, RAG und Modell-Feinsteuerung.

• Evaluieren & Verbessern: Erstellen Sie Bewertungssets, um die Leistung des Agenten bei Klassifizierungs- und Qualitätsprüfungen zu messen. Analysieren Sie Fehler und entwerfen Sie Vertrauens-Scoring / Fallback-Logik, um vertrauenswürdige Ausgaben zu gewährleisten.

• Daten & Integration: Arbeiten Sie mit Fachexperten zusammen, um kommentierte Datensätze vorzubereiten. Integrieren Sie Agent-Outputs in bestehende APIs, leichte Apps und Unternehmens-Workflows.

• MLOps & Experimente: Erstellen Sie wiederholbare, nachverfolgte Experimente mit versionierten Datensätzen, um kontinuierliche, reproduzierbare Verbesserungen zu gewährleisten.

• Agile Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie im Sprint neben Ingenieuren und Datenverwaltern. Präsentieren Sie Methoden, Einschränkungen und Demos für technische und geschäftliche Stakeholder.

Wer du bist

• Ausbildung: Fortgeschrittener Bachelor- oder Masterstudent in AI, Data Science, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Technische Kernkompetenzen: Starke Python-Kenntnisse mit praktischer Erfahrung in PyTorch / TensorFlow, klassischem ML-Tooling, SQL und Git / Docker / Linux. Erfahrung beim Aufbau von leichten Apps ist ein Plus.

• AI/ML-Erfahrung: Praktisches Wissen über den gesamten ML-Lebenszyklus. Bevorzugte Exposition gegenüber LLMs, Agent Frameworks und Belohnungsdesign.

• Domain Interest: Vertrautheit mit Metadaten, Datenkatalogen oder Abstammungslinien. Ein starkes Interesse an der Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und Rückverfolgbarkeit in regulierten Umgebungen.

• Soft Skills: Klares geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch, intellektuelle Neugier, Ausdauer und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Ergebnisse einem nicht-technischen Publikum zu erklären.

Zusätzliche Angaben

• Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf in englischer Sprache in Ihre Bewerbung ein.

• Aufgrund regulatorischer Anforderungen müssen Nicht-EU-/Nicht-EFTA-Bürger eine Bescheinigung ihrer Universität vorlegen, die bestätigt, dass das Praktikum obligatorisch ist und die erforderliche Dauer angibt, sowie eine Immatrikulationsbescheinigung.

• Sie sind derzeit an einer Hochschule (Bachelor- oder Masterstudium) immatrikuliert oder haben Ihr Studium innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate vor dem Praktikumsbeginn abgeschlossen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Weiterentwicklung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.
